# BotSignal.Dev

> BotSignal.Dev is a SaaS platform that analyzes websites for AI discoverability, LLM compatibility, structured data, citation potential, and technical SEO in under 60 seconds.

## About Us
When users ask ChatGPT, Claude, or Perplexity for recommendations, AI models crawl the web to synthesize answers. BotSignal helps founders, developers, and marketers ensure their websites are easily read, understood, and cited by these AI agents. 

We simulate LLM web crawls to calculate an "AI Readiness Score" and provide actionable fixes to improve Information Density, Semantic Clarity, and Entity Authority.

## Audit Modules Explained

BotSignal grades websites across four primary dimensions:
1. **AI Discoverability:** [https://botsignal.dev/docs/discovery](https://botsignal.dev/docs/discovery) - Checking `robots.txt`, `llms.txt`, and crawler firewall access.
2. **Information Density:** [https://botsignal.dev/docs/density](https://botsignal.dev/docs/density) - The ratio of hard, extractable facts versus marketing fluff.
3. **Citation Potential:** [https://botsignal.dev/docs/insights](https://botsignal.dev/docs/insights) - Optimizing content structures (tables, definitions, FAQs) so AI can confidently reference the site.
4. **Technical SEO:** [https://botsignal.dev/docs/seo](https://botsignal.dev/docs/seo) - Inspecting DOM hierarchy, JSON-LD Schema markup, and internal linking structures.
